news.headline: Sources: Cardinals' Gardner Minshew has UCL injury; Michael Wilson out for year
news.summary: Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew probably will need season-ending surgery on his right UCL, sources told ESPN. Michael Wilson, Arizona's top wide receiver, is also out for the season because of a neck injury.
